original: Soon the Chosen Child will appear,\nsee the sign, and fall right into\nmy trap!
I have to do something, or else\nLord Vamdemon will...
Koushirou, can we rest for a bit?\nI'm dead tired.
We have to find Gennai as soon as\npossible!
But it's already been two months.
I'll keep going, no matter how\nmany months it takes.
If we meet Gennai, we can learn\nthe secret behind the Crests!
You know, Koushirou, the fact that\nyou're always curious is what I \nlike about you.
Stop, I'm getting embarrassed.\nAnyway, where's Gennai?
But we didn't even take a break!\nKoushirou!
Huh? If it says that, then we\nshould take a detour.
This area really is full of poop.
I wanna get through this mountain\nas quickly as we can!
But these signs are a huge help.
Seems like this time we should go\nthis way instead.
I did it, I did it! A great\nsuccess!!
I can't fly! Tryin' to fly just\nmakes me fall right back down!
How far are we going to keep\nfalling?
No! I don't wanna go to Hell!
Those who are possessed by greed\nwill fall into Hell.
I don't believe we're possessed by\nany type of greed, but...
No, you are possessed, by the\ngreed of wanting to know\neverything.
Do you want to fall into Hell?!
But Koushirou, that's what I like\nabout you...
But at this rate we're both going\nto fall into Hell!
How do I throw it away?
I don't want to know! I don't want\nto know!
I am Vadermon, the ruler of the\nSacred Mysterious Universe.
I will dispose of the inquisitive\nheart that you've discarded.
It is much more important to\nacquire Cosmic Power.
The fundamentals of Cosmic Power\nlie in your breathing.
Koushirou, don't get sucked into\nthat hogwash!
The correct way to breathe is to\ngenerate alpha rays from your\nright chest...
Huh? Did I dig the pit that deep?
I still haven't gotten the Crest.\nWhat do I do...?
Hm, hmmmmm! I've obtained a good\nheart today.
Excuse me, have you seen a human\nand a Digimon fall into this hole\nanytime recently?
I saw them, I saw them! Please\nwait a moment!
Sorry to keep you waiting! Here's\nthat kid's inquisitive heart!
I'm the Merchant of the Heart\nUniverse. Haven't you come to buy\na heart?
No, I want the Tag and Crest that\nkid was holding!
Good sir, this is a heart shop! I\ndon't sell that kind of thing!
But I've got a fine poop for you.
I'd like to trade with you, you\nknow!
I'll do it! I'll do it!!
There's something I'd like to tell\nyou.
To use Cosmic Power, you must\nthrow everything away.
Hand over all of your personal\nbelongings.
Koushirou, you're right back to\nnormal! Huh? Power's flowin'\nthrough me!
You think you can defeat me?
This is bad! I ain't got enough\npower yet!
If I could get back my inquisitive\nheart...
My curiosity is an important part\nof me. I want to know. I want to\nknow!
Kabuterimon, get up! We'll\ncontinue our adventure together!
Koushirou! What's going on? I'm\ngettin' a ton of energy!
You evolved with the power of the\nCrest, AtlurKabuterimon!
What is this? But just bluffing\nyour way through won't defeat me!
He's taking so long. What's that\nVadermon guy doing?
He left. Who was that Digimon?
I used up way too much energy.
The distortions in this world have\nnot been corrected yet.
Not again. He only says what's\nconvenient...
Let's meet up with everyone again.\nWe'll find a way if we work\ntogether!
"Beware of extreme poop ahead!"\nWhat's extreme poop?
I don't really know, but I don't\nwanna get attacked by some poop.
Let's not go in that direction.
Not "worried" per se, but let's\nkeep going.
"Beware of a bottomless pit of\npoop ahead".
Don't like the sound of that one.
Koushirou, I'm sick of all this\npoop.
Koushirou, you ain't interested in\npoop, are you?
I'm not interested in poop, but\nwhen a sign tells us not to go,\nit concerns me.
